data: When you are subject to a melee attack, use your reaction to take half the damage dealt now and on any melee attack that targets you until the beginning of your next turn.
Prevents the user from being startled one time this turn.
You are immune to first CHA Saving Throw you would have to make this round.
You create a wall of light that protects your allies from Melee Attacks for the duration. While in the light, all damage dealt to you and your allies by melee attacks is halved.
